opening: Live movement throughout training; first moving target has a clear lane, second target teaches curved fire.
Stage progress and target destruction feedback; auto-transition into campaign after training.
First two campaign arenas now require two rounds; later campaign keeps its established rules.
Visible pickup learning checklist in the first three arenas.
combat_readability: Elimination cause and owner in floating feedback and a short combat feed.
Eliminated FFA pilots marked in scoreboard; last survivor still earns the point.
Distinct shield break, armored boss hit, core hit and core sealed states.
AI and player guidance pickups both show trajectories. Laser pickup and charging show straight obstruction-aware lines; allied ships do not falsely block previews.
boss: Tracks target velocity and solves gravity-aware trajectories before locking.
Cross/fan patterns, stellar laser, final broken ring with an indicated opening.
Locked warning paths use live projectile physics and future body positions.
Stable recovery and a single effective core hit per opening.
Shared muzzle geometry between prediction and live volley.
ai: Direct-hit fast path retains full angular search when needed.
Shared pickup/weapon replan invalidation; removed old coupled aim/movement control branch.
Terrain planner predicts nearby curved projectiles once per navigation decision; prunes losing candidates.
Squad pressure chosen by clear lane and loadout; faster role reassessment, wider flank, interception of fast targets.
Online squads share target orders and stagger AI fire without altering human inputs.
orbital: Wider assisted capture zones for all celestial types.
Eligible compact pairs support continuous circular guidance circuits around both bodies.
Bodies, returning self hits and lifetime remain real constraints; not a general N-body periodic-orbit solver.
art: Unified illustrated sci-fi palette, terrain color reduction, broad light planes and atmospheric edges.
512px cached planetary spheres rendered from attributed terrain masks; no per-frame pixel processing.
Mechanical iris boss hulls, lit ship nacelles, streaked impacts and core flash.
In-game art/audio credits and source/license/hash manifest.

validation.browser: Silent desktop UI: menu, campaign cards, tutorial movement/progression, boss fight, art sheet; no observed JS errors. Offline HTML served locally loaded with embedded art.
validation.phone: Release buffering covered by regression tests; no new physical-phone session this iteration.

limits: Visual quality and opening engagement still require player feedback; tests are not retention measurements.
Aim timings are a small local deterministic batch, not a mobile FPS or overall AI win-rate guarantee.
Boss comparisons isolate constant motion or stationary targets; they are not human-play success rates.
No public signaling capacity workflow or 1000-room load test was run.

preservation.offline-v0.12.7: preserved; matches Git content after CRLF normalization
